source: |
  SELECT
    s.invoice_id,
    s.line_no,
    s.invoice_date,
    s.week_start,
    s.customer_id,
    s.branch_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.category,
    s.quantity,
    s.list_unit_price_usd,
    s.discount_pct,
    s.net_revenue_usd,
    s.cogs_usd,
    s.currency,
    s.rebate_alloc_usd,
    p.plan_gross_margin_pct,
    b.branch_name,
    b.region,
    c.customer_name,
    c.segment AS customer_segment,
    c.industry_segment,
    c.account_manager,
    c.payment_terms_days,
    c.credit_limit_usd,
    ar.due_date,
    ar.invoice_amount_usd,
    ar.open_balance_usd,
    ar.as_of_date,
    ar.dispute_date,
    CASE WHEN ar.due_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(ar.as_of_date, ar.due_date) > 30 THEN ar.open_balance_usd ELSE 0 END AS past_due_30_usd,
    CASE WHEN ar.due_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(ar.as_of_date, ar.due_date) > 30 AND cr.is_top_200 THEN ar.open_balance_usd ELSE 0 END AS collections_exposure_top200_usd,
    CASE WHEN ar.invoice_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(ar.as_of_date, 89) AND ar.as_of_date THEN ar.invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END AS billed_last_90_usd,
    COALESCE(
      f.freight_cost_usd * s.net_revenue_usd
        / NULLIF(SUM(s.net_revenue_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY s.week_start, s.branch_id), 0),
      0
    ) AS freight_alloc_usd
  FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_sales_line_rebate_alloc s
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_plan_gross_margin p
    ON s.category = p.category AND s.period_month = p.period_month
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_dim_branch b
    ON s.branch_id = b.branch_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_dim_customer c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_fct_ar_invoice ar
    ON s.invoice_id = ar.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_customer_rank cr
    ON s.customer_id = cr.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_fct_freight f
    ON s.week_start = f.week_start AND s.branch_id = f.branch_id

dimensions:
  - name: Week Start
    expr: week_start
    comment: Monday of the invoice week, used as the primary time grain for weekly dashboards
  - name: Category
    expr: category
    comment: Product category, used by category managers to investigate margin leakage
  - name: Branch
    expr: branch_name
    comment: Selling branch name for geographic margin and cash analysis
  - name: Region
    expr: region
    comment: Branch region for regional roll-up reporting
  - name: Customer Name
    expr: customer_name
    comment: Customer name for account-level margin and AR analysis
  - name: Customer Segment
    expr: customer_segment
    comment: Customer segment (Trade, Retail, Industrial, Government)
  - name: Industry Segment
    expr: industry_segment
    comment: Customer industry segment for cross-industry margin comparison
  - name: Account Manager
    expr: account_manager
    comment: Account manager responsible for the customer relationship
  - name: Currency
    expr: currency
    comment: Transaction currency of the invoice line
  - name: Invoice Date
    expr: invoice_date
    comment: Date the invoice was raised, for daily drill-down
  - name: Due Date
    expr: due_date
    comment: Payment due date on the AR invoice, used by credit control
  - name: Dispute Date
    expr: dispute_date
    comment: Date a dispute was raised on the AR invoice, flags contested balances

measures:
  - name: Net Revenue
    expr: SUM(net_revenue_usd)
    comment: Invoiced revenue after discounts, USD
  - name: List Revenue
    expr: SUM(quantity * list_unit_price_usd)
    comment: Revenue at full list price before any discounts, USD
  - name: Discount Leakage USD
    expr: MEASURE(`List Revenue`) - MEASURE(`Net Revenue`)
    comment: Revenue given away through discounting (list minus net), USD
  - name: COGS
    expr: SUM(cogs_usd)
    comment: Reported cost of goods sold after supplier rebate netting, USD
  - name: Rebate Accrual USD
    expr: SUM(rebate_alloc_usd)
    comment: Supplier rebate accrual allocated to each sales line, USD
  - name: COGS Pre Rebate
    expr: MEASURE(`COGS`) + MEASURE(`Rebate Accrual USD`)
    comment: Cost of goods sold before supplier rebate accrual is netted off, USD
  - name: Gross Margin USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS`)
    comment: Net revenue minus reported COGS (after rebate accrual), USD
  - name: Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Pre Rebate`)
    comment: Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual is applied, USD
  - name: Gross Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Reported gross margin as a share of net revenue, after rebate accrual
  - name: Gross Margin Pre Rebate Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual as a share of net revenue
  - name: Gross Margin Reported Pct
    expr: (MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS`)) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Gross margin as reported after rebate accrual, identical to Gross Margin Pct for clarity in rebate bridge
  - name: Rebate Benefit Bps
    expr: (MEASURE(`Gross Margin Reported Pct`) - MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pre Rebate Pct`)) * 10000
    comment: Basis-point uplift to gross margin delivered by supplier rebate accrual
  - name: Plan Gross Margin USD
    expr: SUM(net_revenue_usd * plan_gross_margin_pct / 100)
    comment: FP&A plan gross margin dollars, derived from revenue-weighted plan rate, USD
  - name: Plan Gross Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Plan Gross Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: FP&A plan gross margin rate, revenue-weighted across categories
  - name: GM vs Plan Bps
    expr: (MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pct`) - MEASURE(`Plan Gross Margin Pct`)) * 10000
    comment: Reported gross margin gap to plan in basis points (negative = leaking below plan)
  - name: Freight Cost USD
    expr: SUM(freight_alloc_usd)
    comment: Outbound freight cost allocated pro-rata to revenue within week and branch, USD
  - name: Contribution Margin USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin USD`) - MEASURE(`Freight Cost USD`)
    comment: Gross margin after deducting allocated freight cost, USD
  - name: Contribution Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Contribution Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Contribution margin as a share of net revenue after freight
  - name: Invoice Lines
    expr: COUNT(1)
    comment: Count of invoice lines, used to normalise per-line metrics
  - name: Price Realisation Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`List Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Fraction of list price actually realised after discounts
  - name: Open AR
    expr: SUM(open_balance_usd)
    comment: Total unpaid AR balance outstanding as of the snapshot date, USD
  - name: Billed Last 90 Days
    expr: SUM(billed_last_90_usd)
    comment: Invoice amounts billed in the trailing 90 days, used as DSO denominator, USD
  - name: DSO Days
    expr: MEASURE(`Open AR`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Billed Last 90 Days`) / 90, 0)
    comment: Days Sales Outstanding calculated from open AR over 90-day billed revenue
  - name: Past Due Over 30 Days
    expr: SUM(past_due_30_usd)
    comment: Open AR balances where payment is more than 30 days overdue, USD

source: |
  SELECT
    s.invoice_id,
    s.line_no,
    s.invoice_date,
    s.week_start,
    s.customer_id,
    s.branch_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.category,
    s.quantity,
    s.list_unit_price_usd,
    s.discount_pct,
    s.net_revenue_usd,
    s.cogs_usd,
    s.currency,
    s.rebate_alloc_usd,
    p.plan_gross_margin_pct,
    b.branch_name,
    b.region,
    c.customer_name,
    c.segment AS customer_segment,
    c.industry_segment,
    c.account_manager,
    c.payment_terms_days,
    c.credit_limit_usd,
    ar.due_date,
    ar.invoice_amount_usd,
    ar.open_balance_usd,
    ar.as_of_date,
    ar.dispute_date,
    CASE WHEN ar.due_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(ar.as_of_date, ar.due_date) > 30 THEN ar.open_balance_usd ELSE 0 END AS past_due_30_usd,
    CASE WHEN ar.due_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(ar.as_of_date, ar.due_date) > 30 AND cr.is_top_200 THEN ar.open_balance_usd ELSE 0 END AS collections_exposure_top200_usd,
    CASE WHEN ar.invoice_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(ar.as_of_date, 89) AND ar.as_of_date THEN ar.invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END AS billed_last_90_usd,
    COALESCE(
      f.freight_cost_usd * s.net_revenue_usd
        / NULLIF(SUM(s.net_revenue_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY s.week_start, s.branch_id), 0),
      0
    ) AS freight_alloc_usd
  FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_sales_line_rebate_alloc s
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_plan_gross_margin p
    ON s.category = p.category AND s.period_month = p.period_month
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_dim_branch b
    ON s.branch_id = b.branch_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_dim_customer c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_fct_ar_invoice ar
    ON s.invoice_id = ar.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_customer_rank cr
    ON s.customer_id = cr.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_fct_freight f
    ON s.week_start = f.week_start AND s.branch_id = f.branch_id

dimensions:

    expr: week_start

  - name: Category

  - name: Branch
    expr: branch_name
    comment: Selling branch name for geographic margin and cash analysis
  - name: Region
    expr: region
    comment: Branch region for regional roll-up reporting
  - name: Customer Name
    expr: customer_name
    comment: Customer name for account-level margin and AR analysis
  - name: Customer Segment
    expr: customer_segment
    comment: Customer segment (Trade, Retail, Industrial, Government)
  - name: Industry Segment
    expr: industry_segment
    comment: Customer industry segment for cross-industry margin comparison
  - name: Account Manager
    expr: account_manager
    comment: Account manager responsible for the customer relationship
  - name: Currency
    expr: currency
    comment: Transaction currency of the invoice line
  - name: Invoice Date
    expr: invoice_date
    comment: Date the invoice was raised, for daily drill-down
  - name: Due Date
    expr: due_date
    comment: Payment due date on the AR invoice, used by credit control
  - name: Dispute Date
    expr: dispute_date
    comment: Date a dispute was raised on the AR invoice, flags contested balances

measures:
  - name: Net Revenue
    expr: SUM(net_revenue_usd)
    comment: Invoiced revenue after discounts, USD
  - name: List Revenue
    expr: SUM(quantity * list_unit_price_usd)
    comment: Revenue at full list price before any discounts, USD
  - name: Discount Leakage USD
    expr: MEASURE(`List Revenue`) - MEASURE(`Net Revenue`)
    comment: Revenue given away through discounting (list minus net), USD
  - name: COGS
    expr: SUM(cogs_usd)
    comment: Reported cost of goods sold after supplier rebate netting, USD
  - name: Rebate Accrual USD
    expr: SUM(rebate_alloc_usd)
    comment: Supplier rebate accrual allocated to each sales line, USD
  - name: COGS Pre Rebate
    expr: MEASURE(`COGS`) + MEASURE(`Rebate Accrual USD`)
    comment: Cost of goods sold before supplier rebate accrual is netted off, USD
  - name: Gross Margin USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS`)
    comment: Net revenue minus reported COGS (after rebate accrual), USD
  - name: Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Pre Rebate`)
    comment: Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual is applied, USD
  - name: Gross Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Reported gross margin as a share of net revenue, after rebate accrual
  - name: Gross Margin Pre Rebate Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual as a share of net revenue
  - name: Gross Margin Reported Pct
    expr: (MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS`)) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Gross margin as reported after rebate accrual, identical to Gross Margin Pct for clarity in rebate bridge
  - name: Rebate Benefit Bps
    expr: (MEASURE(`Gross Margin Reported Pct`) - MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pre Rebate Pct`)) * 10000
    comment: Basis-point uplift to gross margin delivered by supplier rebate accrual
  - name: Plan Gross Margin USD
    expr: SUM(net_revenue_usd * plan_gross_margin_pct / 100)
    comment: FP&A plan gross margin dollars, derived from revenue-weighted plan rate, USD
  - name: Plan Gross Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Plan Gross Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: FP&A plan gross margin rate, revenue-weighted across categories
  - name: GM vs Plan Bps
    expr: (MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pct`) - MEASURE(`Plan Gross Margin Pct`)) * 10000
    comment: Reported gross margin gap to plan in basis points (negative = leaking below plan)
  - name: Freight Cost USD
    expr: SUM(freight_alloc_usd)
    comment: Outbound freight cost allocated pro-rata to revenue within week and branch, USD
  - name: Contribution Margin USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin USD`) - MEASURE(`Freight Cost USD`)
    comment: Gross margin after deducting allocated freight cost, USD
  - name: Contribution Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Contribution Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Contribution margin as a share of net revenue after freight
  - name: Invoice Lines
    expr: COUNT(1)
    comment: Count of invoice lines, used to normalise per-line metrics
  - name: Price Realisation Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`List Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Fraction of list price actually realised after discounts
  - name: Open AR
    expr: SUM(open_balance_usd)
    comment: Total unpaid AR balance outstanding as of the snapshot date, USD
  - name: Billed Last 90 Days
    expr: SUM(billed_last_90_usd)
    comment: Invoice amounts billed in the trailing 90 days, used as DSO denominator, USD
  - name: DSO Days
    expr: MEASURE(`Open AR`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Billed Last 90 Days`) / 90, 0)
    comment: Days Sales Outstanding calculated from open AR over 90-day billed revenue
  - name: Past Due Over 30 Days
    expr: SUM(past_due_30_usd)
    comment: Open AR balances where payment is more than 30 days overdue, USD
  - name: Collections Exposure Top 200
    expr: SUM(collections_exposure_top200_usd)
    comment: Past-due AR over 30 days owed by top-200 customers by revenue, USD
